newsitem.title: USA: Jan cash flow to U.S. stock funds $24 bln--ICI.
newsitem.headline: Jan cash flow to U.S. stock funds $24 bln--ICI.

text.p: Net new cash flows to U.S. stock mutual funds were estimated at $24 billion in January, up from actual inflows of $12.22 billion in December, an industry group said Wednesday.
The Investment Company Institute said bond and income funds had an estimated inflow of $3 billion in January, compared with inflows of $2.80 billion in December.
Net new cash to both types of mutual funds totaled $27 billion in January from $15.02 billion in December.

The monthly estimates are derived from unpublished weekly estimates based on a survey of long-term funds that account for about 97 percent of long-term mutual fund assets. Actual figures for January will be released in two to three weeks.
